scene: The crank rotates the launch pad, revealing three new departures.
picture: Flat side-view along the rotating turntable platform. The player in his orange vest and kite stands centre beside the crank. On the far left, a glass-bottomed boat floats in a canal cradle. Up high above centre, a striped hot-air balloon sways. On the right, an ice sled waits on a frosted chute.
